title: Why am I asked to choose my own password
question: Why am I asked to choose my own password?
answer: Your account was given a starting password. Enter a new password of at least eight characters and press Save; Keep the given password for now postpones the change until a later sign-in. If this does not match what you see, send a screenshot in Help once you are in the app.
looks_like: Choose your own password shows Your new password (8 characters or more), Save and Keep the given password for now.
